items.title: Vince Lateano interviewed by Monk Rowe, San Francisco, California, August 8, 2002
items.q: oh Eddie Duran’s on that, the guitarist, he’s on there.

ctx.x: Willie Colon. Okay, not Willie Colon the New York trombone player. Yeah I don’t think Poncho did this. Anyway so we show up at the Coast Recorders and Tania is there and we meet her and she speaks very little English. And no rehearsal or anything we’re just in the studio and getting ready to do this thing. And so nothing is written out. And she says, I mean well let’s hear what you’re going to do. So she launches into this tune, this first tune, and we all looked at each other like what are we gonna do my God? I…
What happened to her is she still around?
